query:
SELECT p.record_type AS "kind!: String", p.name AS "name!: String", CASE WHEN c.filetype IN ('html', 'hyperlink') THEN coalesce(c.html_content, '') ELSE coalesce(CAST(c.content AS TEXT), '') END AS "content!: String"
           FROM pages p JOIN content c ON c.record_type = 'document' AND c.record_id = p.document_id AND c.language_code IN ('EN', ?2)
           WHERE p.url = ?1
           ORDER BY CASE WHEN c.language_code = 'EN' THEN 2 ELSE 1 END LIMIT 1
